title: 第2章 我是你爸爸
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
盛素华接过照片仔细的看了看，发现照片中的人确实是自己的婆婆。

    虽然她婆婆死的早，可每年祭拜时，看到的那张黑白照片，还是很清楚。

    盛素华的手有些颤抖，“请问，您今年......贵庚？”对着一个和自己丈夫年轻时候一样的脸，说敬语实在是有些奇怪。

    “我已经60岁了。”郁凡仔细的回想了下曾经的记忆，“我是1962年出生的。”

    “抱歉，时间真的太久了，年纪大了，有些糊涂了。”郁凡有些不好意思，毕竟对于他来说，不仅仅只是40年而已。

    “你们确定他真的有60岁了吗？你们看这长相能像是60岁的人吗？”盛素华还是忍不住去问民警。

    民警苦笑着说：“虽然不可置信，可我们这几天认真调查过，郁先生是在80年代初期隐居山林的，很多东西还是能查到的，我们这边能确定郁先生的身份，或许您问问您丈夫，核实一下。”

    听到这句话，盛素华眼睛不由一红，喃喃道：“我也想问问，可是如今他......”

    说着一行清泪便流了下来，盛素华擦擦眼泪，歉意的说：“抱歉，我失态了。”

    盛素华将人迎了进来，“这件事，我暂时做不了决定，或许你们进来看看就知道了。”

    郁凡走进公寓内，才发现公寓真的小的可怜，大概只有60平左右，两室一厅，客厅沙发都直接给改成了床。

    盛素华打开主卧的门，郁凡一眼就看到了躺在床上的儿子。

    郁凡大步走了过去，“怎么回事？”

    神识快速的在郁嘉庆身体上扫了一遍，脑颅淤血，身体机能受损，导致严重失血性昏迷。

    “高空坠落，手术完后有段时间了，可是人一直没有清醒，手中的钱也不够了，只能将人带回家了。”

    说着，盛素华又忍不住眼红了。

    家里的顶梁柱倒了，她的天都快塌了，要不是还有孩子在帮忙照顾，自己可能也撑不住了。

    小民警虽然对于此事挺同情的，可各家都有自己为难的事情，他偷偷在桌上放了点钱，打了声招呼便离开了。

    “虽然我不清楚您是不是我公公，可您和我丈夫确实长得很像，您也没地方可以去，先留下来吧。”

    盛素华知道现在多一个人，对于这个家庭来说是极其为难的，可她也不愿意让这个应该和她丈夫有关系的人流落街头。

    “您先坐，我先去做饭。”盛素华一边思考着让儿子和这个新认的公公挤一挤，一边去厨房忙碌了起来。

    郁凡看着昏迷中的郁嘉庆，忍不住庆幸还好自己回来了，不然这孩子可能一辈子只能躺在床上了。
content_en:
Sheng Suhua took the photo and looked at it carefully, and found that the person in the photo was indeed her mother-in-law.

Although her mother-in-law died young, the black-and-white photo she saw during her annual memorial service was still very clear.

Sheng Suhua's hands were trembling a little, "Excuse me, this year... your Geng?" It was a bit strange to say honorific to a face that looked like her husband's when he was young.

"I am 60 years old." Yu Fan carefully recalled his past memories, "I was born in 1962."

"Sorry, it's been too long. I'm a little confused now that I'm old." Yu Fan was a little embarrassed. After all, for him, it was more than just 40 years.

"Are you sure he is really 60 years old? Do you think he looks like a 60-year-old person?" Sheng Suhua still couldn't help but ask the police.

The policeman smiled bitterly and said: "Although it is unbelievable, we have conducted serious investigations in the past few days. Mr. Yu lived in seclusion in the mountains and forests in the early 1980s. Many things can still be found. We can confirm Mr. Yu's identity here. Maybe you can ask your husband to verify it."

Hearing this, Sheng Suhua's eyes turned red and she murmured, "I also wanted to ask, but now he..."

As she spoke, tears flowed down her face. Sheng Suhua wiped her tears and said apologetically: "I'm sorry, I lost my composure."

Sheng Suhua welcomed the people in, "I can't make a decision on this matter yet. Maybe you can come in and take a look."

When Yu Fan walked into the apartment, he realized that the apartment was really small, only about 60 square meters, with two bedrooms and one living room, and the sofa in the living room was directly converted into a bed.

Sheng Suhua opened the door of the master bedroom, and Yu Fan immediately saw his son lying on the bed.

Yu Fan strode over, "What's going on?"

His consciousness quickly scanned Yu Jiaqing's body, and he found brain congestion, damaged body functions, and severe hemorrhagic coma.

"Falled from a high altitude. It has been a while since the operation, but the person has not regained consciousness and the money in hand is not enough, so I can only take the person home."

Saying that, Sheng Suhua couldn't help but feel jealous again.

The backbone of the family has collapsed, and her sky is about to collapse. If it weren't for the children helping to take care of her, she might not be able to hold on.

Although the little policeman was quite sympathetic to the matter, every family had its own difficulties. He secretly put some money on the table, said hello and left.

"Although I don't know if you are my father-in-law, you and my husband do look very similar. You have nowhere to go, so you should stay for now."

Sheng Suhua knew that it would be extremely difficult for the family to have one more person, but she was not willing to let this person who should be related to her husband live on the street.

"You sit down first, and I'll go cook first." Sheng Suhua thought about letting her son squeeze in with this new father-in-law, and then went to the kitchen to get busy.

Yu Fan looked at the unconscious Yu Jiaqing and couldn't help but feel glad that he was back, otherwise the child might have to lie in bed for the rest of his life.
